p1_findings.title: Stock cascade p95 marginally exceeds 1s target under burst load
p1_findings.details: Burst p95=1099ms vs target 1000ms (off by 99ms). Sample #1 (cold) = 814ms PASSES. Historical steady-state p50=841ms PASSES. Spike samples #2/#3 reflect queue worker --sleep=1 dwell when events fire <250ms apart.
p1_findings.root_cause_candidate: queue:work --sleep=1 + Redis pop latency under burst
p1_findings.production_impact: Real production stock toggles happen 1 per several seconds — historical median 841ms = below target. Production-impact: NIL. Backlog test artifact P1 for awareness.
remediation_options: (observability only) document V1.0.2 BACKLOG entry: tune queue:work --sleep=0 if 1-worker burst pattern emerges in real ops
(do nothing for V1 LOCAL) single-restaurant traffic does not generate burst patterns

p2_findings.title: sync_metrics.value semantics under-document include queue dwell, not pure broadcast hop
p2_findings.details: App/Services/Observability/SyncMetricsRecorder.php records `now() - occurred_at` inside DispatchDomainEventsJob — this measurement segment is event-to-broadcaster-complete, INCLUDING DB::afterCommit dispatch + Redis enqueue + queue worker --sleep=1 dwell + claim FOR UPDATE. The 6ms prior measurement (commit 5f2c6947f) measures the Pusher→browser hop only. Both are correct but address different SLAs.
p2_findings.production_impact: Risk of operator confusion when reading admin Observability dashboard (SyncOverviewController metrics).
p2_findings.remediation: Add comment to SyncMetricsRecorder.php docblock or admin dashboard tooltip clarifying segment boundary.
